'''ID-75 Heavy Assault Droid''' was a droid model in use during the [[Galactic War]]. [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] captain [[Ayor-v9]] used several ID-75 Heavy Assault Droids for protection of his base in the tunnels of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and considered them to be "his family".<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
ID-75 Heavy Assault Droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on Hoth.
